name: Synthetic Data: Loopmoor
subtitle: Distill, synthesize, judge
shortDescription: Build the loop where AI trains AI: distil a teacher, generate and filter data, catch biased judges, see model collapse, rate a self-play ladder. Offline labs.
longDescription:
Training AI with AI, taught by labs you run on your phone: Loopmoor is a graduate-level course on synthetic data, distillation and self-improvement. Everything works offline, with no account.

HOW IT WORKS
Eight stations make a loop: why AI trains AI, knowledge distillation, synthetic data generation, filtering and verification, LLM-as-judge and its biases, model collapse and contamination, self-play and self-improvement, and evaluating recursive training. Each station has short cards (3 to 8 minutes), a lab you build, and a quick check computed from what you built.

SEE EVERY EQUATION
Every equation is shown after a simulation of a real situation: a master teaching an apprentice with soft hints, a question factory stamping out duplicates, an airport scanner and a panel of noisy voters, a biased referee, photocopies of photocopies, two chess clubs rating each other, and a food label for data. Tap a symbol to see it inside the simulation, with live numbers.

SOURCES YOU CAN OPEN
Cards cite primary papers (distillation, Self-Instruct, STaR, LLM-as-judge, model collapse, weak-to-strong and more) and university course pages. Tap a source to open it in a sheet and come back to exactly where you were. If you are offline you still see the stored reference.

FOR LEARNERS
- 8 units, 128 questions with worked solutions, 8 labs
- Gentle replay of misses, "good place to stop" screens, no streak pressure
- A- / A+ text size from 85% to 200%
- Content as of 2026-11-17 card for fast-moving facts
- Toy-scale simulations: they show mechanisms, not results for any real system
- Written and source-checked by our team; not reviewed by an external expert

FREE WITH OPTIONAL ADS
The app is free with ads at natural breaks, never during a lab or quiz. Optional videos earn credits for bonus rounds. Ad-Free Monthly removes ads only: $3.99 per month after a 7-day free trial. Cancel anytime in your account settings; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle.

Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are in the app under More.
